ig_caption:
Tue, Nov 24: 4,635 deer reported statewide (2,446 antlered, 2,189 antlerless). Season total: 213,005.

Antlered deer made up 53% of new reports Tuesday, down from 56% Monday. The top two counties for new reports both leaned antlerless: Sanilac with 69 antlerless to 58 antlered, and Newaygo with 70 to 50.
